leigh_sales: Audry from Solstice Health asked for a focused POC next Wed to validate throughput and tail latency for a triage chat + embedding retrieval pattern. They expect steady 600 qps during business hours, short spikes to 1.5k qps for weekends. Can we do a 3-hour waveform test?

andre_se: Yup. Plan: 15m cold warmup, 90m stepped sustained test (600->1500 qps), 45m peak soak at 1500 qps, 30m cooldown. We'll log p50/p95/p99/p99.9, GPU mem/GPU util, and kv cache hit ratio. Model combo: redwood/medical-chat-7b + retail-embed-2k for embeddings. We'll run two modes: unified route (chat does embedded lookup inline) and split route (dedicated embedding route) to compare head-of-line effects.

leigh_sales: Audry confirmed.
